messages.subject: R code for "stacking" using tidyverse
parts:
Hello all,

I realize that this is more of an R question, but many in this group have "stacked" their "y" data matrix for their unmarkedFramePCount and other unmarkedFrames. I currently have my data in the standard RxJ matrix of repeated count data, for example for visit-by-year:

visit1-2006     visit2-2006    visit3-2006     visit1-2007     visit2-2007     visit3-2007     visit1-2008     visit2-2008     visit3-2008       ...
    4                      10                  3                   10                   1                      0                    3                   7                     9                 ...
    4                       12                 2                    1                    5                      1                    0                   4                     11               ...
    ...

Is there a simple set of code (probably from dplyr/tidyverse to reorganized in a "stacked manner, for example:

visit 1     visit2   visit3    ...
   4            10        3             
  10            1         0
   3             7         9
   4            12        2
   1             5         1
   0             4         11
  ...

And of course then matching up the obsCovs with the proper observations as well as a dataframe with RxJ rows in site-major order.

Thank you!

-Aaron

messages.author: 40e173783f466ae0
messages.subject: Re: R code for "stacking" using tidyverse
parts:
If you want a tidyverse solution....

pivot_longer(1:9, names_to='var',values_to='val')%>%
   separate(col=var, into=c('visit', 'year'),sep='-')%>%
     pivot_wider(names_from='visit', values_from='val')%>%



That's the gist. More verbose than Ben's solution. Might need to tweak it it given the other columns in the data set. The 1:9 is just a place holder for however many 'y' columns you have.
